answer:
I fixed the Meal plan page so it fits an iPhone without sideways scrolling. I haven't opened it on a phone, so check it there.

The old page forced the table to 900px wide, which is why you had to scroll. On a narrow screen, each day now shows as its own card. The day name is the heading, and each meal sits on its own line with its label (Breakfast, Lunch and so on). Empty notes are hidden. On wider screens it's still a normal table.

The note's data didn't change, only the page layout.
